content: How does the agent interact with the BSV wallet? What API endpoints are most important?
Let me look up my knowledge about wallet integration.

The agent communicates with bsv-wallet-cli running on localhost:3322 via the BRC-100 wallet API. The most critical endpoints are: createAction (for building and signing transactions), getPublicKey (identity), createSignature (signing), and encrypt/decrypt (BRC-42 derived key encryption). The wallet must be funded before the agent can operate.

The agent tracks spending at multiple levels: per-task limits (default 20M sats), per-hour rate limits, and session totals. Every cost is recorded in transcript events. When the budget is exhausted, the agent stops gracefully. On-chain proofs provide auditability. Cost optimization involves caching, memory search (which is free since it is local BM25), and minimizing redundant LLM calls.
